name: 北美城市改造
description: 只改 North America 城市的两件事：城市尸潮数量降到默认的三分之一左右；住宅地块里那三分之一随机民居改成商铺。纯数据 mod，不动本体任何文件，启用与否由玩家自己决定。
//en_us_description: Two changes for North America cities only: city horde size cut to roughly a third of default, and part of the randomized residential slots in city blocks turned into shops. Pure data mod; no core files are touched, and it is opt-in.
